name.zh: 把敌人的注意力拉到自己身上

summary.zh: 让能承伤的人接管危险，给脆弱队友腾出空间。
summary.en: Put danger on a durable unit to free a vulnerable ally.

rules.zh: 敌人按威胁或目标规则选择攻击对象，玩家用嘲讽、挑衅或其他手段改变这个选择。拉住敌人后还要安排距离、防护和治疗；目标指示线或转身动作说明谁正在承压。
rules.en: Enemies select targets using threat or targeting rules. Taunts and related tools change that choice. The new target still needs positioning, protection and healing, while target lines or turning animations show where pressure moved.

loop.en: Notice a vulnerable ally being targeted

loop.zh: 检查目标是否再次转移
loop.en: Check whether enemies change targets again

decisions.zh: 把所有敌人拉来可能保护队友，也可能超过自己的承伤能力。
decisions.en: Pulling every enemy protects allies but may exceed one unit’s durability.

decisions.zh: 立即拉走敌人，还是等队友用完位移后再接手？
decisions.en: Redirect immediately or wait until an ally has used their escape?

effect.zh: 持续短需要反复维护，持续长则更依赖一次正确选人。
effect.en: Short effects need upkeep; long effects depend on choosing the right target.

effect.zh: 明确显示目标变化，让玩家能判断保护是否生效。
effect.en: Clear target changes let players judge whether protection worked.

contrast.zh: 龙腾世纪的队伍更容易形成专门承伤分工；恐怖黎明把引敌附在可用于个人构筑的战吼上。
contrast.en: Dragon Age supports dedicated party roles; Grim Dawn attaches redirection to a shout within a character build.

combination.zh: 组合提案：救援需要连续读条，另一位玩家可用挑衅把敌人拉开，但要承担这段时间全部追击。
combination.en: Design proposal: reviving requires a continuous channel, while another player taunts enemies away and survives the pursuit.

setup.zh: 治疗者被两名敌人追击，护卫还有护盾。
setup.en: Two enemies chase the healer while the guard still has a shield.

result.zh: 敌人改打护卫，治疗者能恢复施法。
result.en: Enemies turn to the guard, letting the healer cast again.

next.zh: 护盾快破时决定撤退还是再次挑衅。
next.en: As the shield weakens, choose between retreating and taunting again.

firstStep.zh: 做两个友方单位、两个敌人和一种强制换目标效果。
firstStep.en: Use two allies, two enemies and one target-redirection effect.

pitfall.zh: 别让嘲讽变成永远安全的按钮；承伤与位置要产生后果。
pitfall.en: Redirection should have durability and positioning consequences.

test.zh: 玩家是否能看出敌人换了目标，并据此移动或治疗？
test.en: Can players notice a target switch and respond with movement or healing?
